about: Slides for the recorded walkthrough of the case, opened with Present (P) in the docs site. English only. Each slide has a section, a theme (indigo, lavender, butter, peach, pistachio, paper, night) and a layout (cover, section, points, statement, stats, rows, close). Media paths are repo-relative. Every number here is checked against docs/case/*.md.
